subject: Observed compute build success; one-shot heavy-build lease closed
body: Observed compute private build.log finished release profile successfully with EXIT=0; a fresh process inventory shows no cargo/rustc/Mesa/ninja compilation. Close the one-shot lease for cargo109993/rustc110011 as finished, not reusable. No new heavy build is authorized by this close. Compute still needs to publish final command/artifact hashes/current STATUS and the concrete TGP2 header/resource-manifest definitions; counts alone remain insufficient for the compiler owner to enable v2 lowering. I performed read-only source inspection and board posts only, no compilation or production edit.
